summary.headline: Venus Enters the Signs
summary.text: Astrological judgments for Venus entering Cancer through Sagittarius, forecasting weather, rain, winds, agriculture, markets, health, ships, travelers, women, musicians, and rulers. Authorities cited include Hermes, ʿAbd al-Jalīl Sanjarī, and Ḥāsib Makkī, with differing predictions for northern and southern directions.
